The transition from the tenth rank to the eleventh rank is a leap in the essence of life.

An eleventh-order life form stood at the pinnacle just beneath the strongest beings, capable of comprehending the rules of the universe far beyond what a tenth-order being could.

*Standing high and looking far wasn’t just about physical height; it was about the height of life’s levels.*

Why could the strongest beings easily reach the sixth realm of time and space? It was because they had completed the “landing,” seeing further down the riverbanks of time.

Now Lin Yuan was the same.

The elevation of his life level not only allowed Lin Yuan to sense the subtle fluctuations of many rules with ease, but it also enhanced his Against-Heaven’s Understanding to a terrifying degree.

“Your understanding defies heaven, sensing the origin source of time and space, elevating your comprehension of the spatiotemporal fusion rule…”

…

“Your understanding defies heaven, comprehending the secret skill ‘Milky Way,’ elevating your comprehension of the spatiotemporal fusion rule…”

…

In just a few dozen breaths, Lin Yuan’s insights into the spatiotemporal fusion rule surpassed the accumulation of one to two hundred years.

In the Boundless Void, after Lin Yuan comprehended the sixth realm of time and space, he still stayed in that world for over a hundred years, yet the progress in the spatiotemporal fusion rule was minimal.

But even minimal progress, accumulated over a hundred or two hundred years, was still considerable.

Yet now, Lin Yuan, having initially stepped into the eleventh order, quickly surpassed it.

*”At this rate of understanding, perhaps before reaching the ultimate goal, I might elevate the spatiotemporal fusion rule to the seventh realm?”*

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up.

The seventh realm of spatiotemporal fusion? A realm most twelfth-order beings in the universe had never reached. The strongest beings, standing “on the bank,” could easily reach the sixth realm, but the seventh realm?

According to the records within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, very few twelfth-order beings in the universe, who hadn’t yet weathered the first cosmic cataclysm, reached the seventh realm of spatiotemporal fusion.

Even those who did achieved it near the end of an almost complete cosmic era, just before the collapse of the universe.

Normally, understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule at the seventh realm meant one could survive the annihilation of the universe’s collapse with little problem.

Such beings were rare even in the more vast and boundless Chaos Void.

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts; though the journey from the sixth to the seventh realm of time and space seemed a single realm apart, it was immensely long. Lin Yuan merely felt that with his current eleventh-order comprehension speed, he stood a chance of grasping the seventh realm.

As to whether he could actually comprehend it in the end, there was no certainty; there were too many variables in between.

Just as when Lin Yuan was in the first or second layer, facing the question of becoming the strongest?

The leap was too vast to estimate.

…

“The focus of eleventh-order cultivation should be on the physical body and rule comprehension.”

Lin Yuan assessed himself and thought silently.

For the physical body, one should train the “Xuanhuang Physique” to level eleven perfect as much as possible.

Thinking about the enormous resources required for the “Xuanhuang Physique,” Lin Yuan involuntarily felt a stronger urge to venture to super-large battlefields.

Those resources were hard for human civilization to accumulate in a short period.

But with the help of many eleventh-order beings among the Starry Sky Races, there was hope.

At least he could gather a significant portion of it.

…

Physical training involved honing the “Xuanhuang Physique.”

For rule comprehension, the focus was naturally on the spatiotemporal fusion rule, supplemented by other pillar-level fusion rules.

If possible, Lin Yuan still wanted to see if he could comprehend the Chaos Rule.

There was no precedent for the Chaos Rule, but as Lin Yuan estimated, the difficulty of comprehending the Chaos Rule at the eleventh order was even greater than reaching the seventh realm of time and space.

Otherwise, it wouldn’t be considered a legendary feat for both Xuanhuang and Demonic Jade Tower Master to believe that achieving the ultimate by comprehending the Chaos Rule was the stuff of legends.

…

Apart from the physical body and rule comprehension,

Lin Yuan’s internal world was also slowly transforming.

When he reached the eleventh order, the massive Chaos Void Origin he swallowed mostly settled in the depths of his internal world.

With Lin Yuan’s current life level, he couldn’t quickly convert all these Chaos Void Origins into foundation, but he could slowly absorb and transform.

When Lin Yuan aimed for the ultimate, all this transformation and accumulation would erupt, propelling him to an unprecedented peak.

…

Just as Lin Yuan was getting accustomed to the immense benefits of the eleventh-order life level,

an official announcement was made by human civilization.

It stated that human civilization had given birth to another eleventh-order evolver.

An eleventh-order evolver, ranked just below the strongest beings, was celebrated by this pinnacle race each time one emerged.

Previously, when Nalan broke through to the eleventh order, an eleventh-order gala was held, attracting many forces within human civilization to congratulate.

Now, human civilization witnessed the birth of another new eleventh-order evolver.

Initially, many forces within human civilization were curious about which ancient tenth-order evolver ascended to this new eleventh order.

Only to discover that this new eleventh order was actually the Galaxy Master.

From reaching the sixth rank and becoming the Peak Master of the Red Kun Lineage, to now stepping into the eleventh rank.

The Galaxy Master had taken merely a few hundred years, less than a millennium.

Such astonishing speed of advancement left numerous citizens within human civilization bewildered.

…

*”The Galaxy Master… He reached the eleventh rank?”* The Black Star Lord was chatting idly with the Lustrous Star Master and other tenth-grade beings.

Ever since comprehending the pillar-level fusion rule second realm, the Black Star Lord had relaxed, as stepping into the eleventh order was just a matter of time.

He even often took the stance of a forerunner, encouraging his fellow evolvers of the same layer from before.
